name: Validate Prisma schema on change
description: Runs prisma validate and prisma format whenever schema.prisma is saved. Catches schema errors immediately and keeps formatting consistent. Also reminds developer to update the database-schema steering file.

action.command: cd apps/api && npx prisma validate && npx prisma format && echo '✅ Schema valid. Remember to update .kiro/steering/database-schema.md with your new models.'
action.description: Validate and format the Prisma schema
